{{Quote|Be careful. If you go over the edge I can't promise I'll catch you.|Johun Othone to Tarsus Valorum, shortly before Valorum fell off the edge of the landing platform|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>}}
In [[990 BBY]], the [[Anti-Republic Liberation Front]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization '''attempted to kidnap''' former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] while he was on a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. The terrorist group, led by the [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Kelad'den]], [[Death/Legends|murdered]] servants of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Serenno]] [[House Nalju/Legends|House Nalju]] and replaced them with their own members. The party landed on a remote landing pad provided by the House and, when Valorum disembarked with his guard, the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cyndra]] detonated explosives which destroyed [[New Dawn (Emissary-class shuttle)|the former Chancellor's ship]] and killed the entire crew. [[Johun Othone]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who voluntarily headed Valorum's security, defended the former chancellor against the [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].

Two [[Human/Legends|Human]] assassins were killed first by Othone and a third was killed by Kelad'den when he attempted to flee from the battle. The Twi'lek warrior was the last to remain after Cyndra and [[Paak]] fled the encounter, and he alone sparred with Othone. Although Kelad'den initially overpowered Othone with his skills, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] eventually attempted to sacrifice himself for the former Chancellor by taking himself and the Twi'lek into a plunge off the fifty meter high landing platform.

Kelad'den's neck had been broken during the fall but, due to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Othone survived. In gratitude, Valorum decided to grant a request of Othone's, and petitioned the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to create a memorial for all the Jedi who died in [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|battle]] on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Everything we need is right here. We have the weapons, and we're all trained to use them.''"<br />"''We know where and when the Chancellor is coming. What else is there?|Kelad'den trying to convince the ARLF to go through with his plan to capture Tarsus Valorum|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />}}
[[File:Tarsus_Valorum-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Tarsus Valorum, whose safety was jeopardized by the machinations of the ARLF.]]
In [[990 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Zannah]] was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] by her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], to sow seeds of confusion that would distract the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] subtle acts. The [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] gathered contacts, seducing a red-skinned [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] warrior [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Kelad'den]] over a period of a few months under the pretense that she was Rainah, an employee at the Republic embassy. Zannah had known that the Twi'lek was part of a small, radical anti-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] faction and was determined to use that to the advantage of the Sith.

She convinced Kelad'den to bring her to a meeting of the group, known as the [[Anti-Republic Liberation Front]], to further bring them under her control. The Twi'lek gave a speech to those present at the gathering, using words largely fed to him by Zannah. The Sith relied on Kelad'den's eloquence and her own [[Mind trick/Legends|prodding]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to convince the members of the organization to follow through with the plan she had persuaded the Twi'lek to suggest. Within minutes, members involved began to undertake the details of the plot which involved taking captive [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic emissary]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]], who was the Republic's previous [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]. The anti-Republic faction would strike when the former Supreme Chancellor arrived to appeal to the [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Counts of Serenno]] about ceasing to fund organizations critical of the Republic. The morning after, Zannah left the group to its own devices and traveled to the Sith encampment on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]].

The members in charge of executing the strategy were required to take the place of six of [[House Nalju/Legends|House Nalju's]] employees and to lay out explosives on the landing pad selected for the diplomatic mission by the Great House, one of the most powerful [[Great Houses/Legends|families]] on Serenno. The ARLF selected Kelad'den to lead the five others on the mission, including two senior members&mdash;a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] named [[Cyndra]] and a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] known as [[Paak]]&mdash;as well as three other members of the faction.

==The attempt==
===Arrival===
{{Quote|Not my first choice of places to touch down.''"<br />"''Well, I did ask Nalju to let us land someplace remote.|Johun Othone discusses the landing platform with Tarsus Valorum|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />}}
[[File:Johun_Othone.jpg|thumb|left|190px|[[Johun Othone]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and the former [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor's]] friend.]]
The [[New Dawn (Emissary-class shuttle)|''New Dawn'']] touched down on a platform which protruded from a cliff and extended over the ocean, a landing that [[Johun Othone]], Valorum's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] adviser, was not fond of. A few moments after descending the ramp to the platform, the Jedi was [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbed]] by a strong warning through the Force. He noticed that those ahead on the platform whom he had presumed to be members of House Nalju were armed, and that explosives were hidden under the landing platform. However, this forewarning did nothing to save those who were still aboard the ''New Dawn'' when the Chiss woman Othone had also noticed detonated charges which destroyed both the ship and much of the platform. As the end of the walkway twisted and began to bend downward due to the missing landing pad, Valorum was thrown off the edge. Othone managed to save him, though, catching the former Chancellor by his cape, while simultaneously deflecting [[Laser/Legends|blaster fire]] with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

Othone's three assailants abandoned their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] in favor of [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibroswords]] and swept towards him, slashing at his neck and stomach. In an attempt to whittle down their numbers one on one, the Jedi pushed the female attacker into one of his other opponents and faced the remaining one. Othone now pushed aggressively, ending his adversary's life. The woman and the other man were upright again, and the female charged. Instead of parrying, the Jedi dodged her blow and grabbed her by the wrist, pulling her down onto him, while placing his feet on her stomach and hurling her off the edge of the platform. Seeing that he was now alone against a superior foe, the remaining assailant fled. As he ran past Kelad'den, however, he was slashed in the [[Throat/Legends|throat]] by one of the crescent-shaped weapons wielded by the Twi'lek, effectively preventing his desertion. However, Cyndra and Paak were able to flee without retribution as they were too far away to be reached.

===The Twi'lek warrior===
{{Quote|I've always wanted to test my skills against a Jedi.|Kelad'den to Johun Othone|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />}}
The Twi'lek offered his challenge and Othone, in order to finish the battle, charged forward to [[Shiak|impale]] his adversary with his lightsaber. Kelad'den dodged, and slashed the former Chancellor's bodyguard's right arm. Readjusting to his enemy's skill, the Jedi attempted to drive the Twi'lek back, knowing that his weapons were less effective at range. As his frustration grew with his inability to land a blow, Othone overstretched, and fell prey to Kelad'den's blades. The Jedi took two hits, one to his face, the other to his left side, then head-butted the Twi'lek, breaking his nose.

After Kelad'den landed several blows and drove him to the edge of the platform, Othone recognized that his opponent could best him easily no matter how hard he fought. He decided on sacrificing himself for Valorum as a course of action, remembering the Jedi [[Jedi Code/Legends|adage]], ''"There is no death; there is only the Force."'' Dropping his weapon, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] lunged for his enemy and grabbed the Twi'lek's shirt. He then leaned back over the brink and fell down towards the [[Water/Legends|water]]. The shock of the fall caused Kelad'den to break his neck but, due to the Force, Othone survived. Somehow, the Jedi still found the strength to climb the fifty meters to the landing pad, where Valorum helped him up.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|You saved my life. I can never repay you for what you have done, but if there is ever anything you want of me you need only ask.''"<br />"''There is one thing. Hire yourself a kriffing security team.|Tarsus Valorum to Johun Othone, shortly after the duel|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />}}
The outrage generated from the attempt to abduct Valorum caused the [[Count/Legends|Counts]] of Serenno to pledge to eradicate separatist movements. It also affected Valorum in that he had the gratitude to petition the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to erect a monument for the Jedi [[Ruusan campaign|slain]] on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].

Darth Zannah's involvement in this event caused her to be captured by Cyndra and brought to [[Hetton]], the leader of the ARLF.

==Behind the scenes==
The Duel on Serenno was written and conceived by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] for his [[2007]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''. The event was used to further develop the character Johun Othone. The repercussions of Zannah's involvement led to the [[Duel on Ambria (990 BBY)|Duel on Ambria]].
